adjudication.aggregation: every one of five seeds must satisfy every bound
adjudication.legacy_request_total_p95_delta_ns: reported diagnostic only; it does not adjudicate v4

attempt_policy.eligibility: first structurally valid complete attempt in the retained predecessor chain
attempt_policy.rerun_scope: complete five-seed, three-policy matrix under a new attempt ID

gate7_operating_point.qualification: unqualified frozen systems operating point; Gate 2 v2 did not select or qualify a threshold

gptcache.miss_handler: deterministic recorded-response-v2 payload carrying independent concept and source-text provenance; no network or live LLM
gptcache.similarity: cosine reconstructed from normalized FAISS squared L2

onnx.warmup_rule: first hot text IDs in canonical order; cycle only in development smoke mode

power_observations.availability_limitation: point observations cannot prove uninterrupted AC between observations

process_isolation: one fresh child process and process-lifetime temporary storage directory per seed/policy

resource_measurement.collection_timing: sample_started_monotonic_ns, sample_completed_monotonic_ns, and sample_collection_ns reconcile exactly
resource_measurement.formal_peak: maximum mandatory or periodic external sampled RSS
resource_measurement.incremental_baseline: child RSS after model warmup and before manager construction
resource_measurement.method: external parent psutil sampling plus child OS high-water RSS
resource_measurement.os_high_water_role: diagnostic only; includes process startup before the formal window

semantic_guardrail.rule: fail on any direct or component-derived labeled-negative hit; pending on unlabeled cross-component hits; otherwise pass

storage_isolation: fresh SQLite database and FAISS index per seed/policy

timing_scope.embedding: tokenization, ONNX inference, mean pooling, and normalization
timing_scope.end_to_end: raw text entering GPTCache adapt until adapt returns after response materialization
timing_scope.policy_inclusive: outer policy calls including synchronous nested cleanup
timing_scope.post_embedding: GPTCache adapter, SQLite/FAISS lookup or save, similarity, policy, and response materialization after embedding
timing_scope.post_return_evidence: provenance resolution, semantic classification, structural checks, embedding evidence derivation, and post-loop asset rehashing occur after adapter return and are excluded from service latency but required before evidence acceptance
timing_scope.quantiles: nearest rank: one-based ceil(q*N) over raw samples
timing_scope.request_logging: buffered and written after each child exits; excluded from request timing
timing_scope.residual: orchestration, normalization, conversions, and timer overhead not assigned elsewhere
timing_scope.response_return: local recorded JSON response conversion plus propagation from the final response callback through adapt return
